tasks.title: Move the PDF toolkit into one lazy lib/pdf module with a cached, classifying loader
tasks.dod: loadPdfKit() imports lib/pdf/invoice-pdf-kit once per visit and classifies a failed import as offline or new-version; unit tests for the cache and both classifications pass.

tasks.title: Route every PDF trigger through usePdfAction and warm the toolkit in the editor when idle
tasks.dod: Every PDF trigger calls usePdfAction, which shows preparing / try again / reload states and reports generation failures to Sentry with pdf.stage; no file outside lib/pdf statically imports the toolkit (lint no-restricted-imports); component tests cover each state.

tasks.title: Add the build-output PDF chunk check to CI and e2e tests for first PDF, offline and new-version
tasks.dod: scripts/check-pdf-chunks.ts fails the CI build when a non-editor route's initial chunks contain @react-pdf/renderer and passes on this branch; the PDF e2e (no fetch on open, reuse, 20-run p95 ≤ 3 s at 10 Mbit/s, offline, missing chunk) passes.

tasks.title: Remove the unused UI components and their packages, drop uuid, and keep one theme switcher
tasks.dod: components/ui holds no unused component, package.json drops the packages only they used plus uuid and @types/uuid, one components/theme-toggle.tsx serves the landing page and the app, and build, lint and every test pass.

tasks.title: Mount the editor's confirmation dialog in the invoice-editor modal container
tasks.dod: The editor's ConfirmationModal is rendered only by InvoiceEditorModalContainer, the F-47 onClose behaviour is kept, and the existing confirmation-modal component tests pass.

tasks.title: Rewrite the README setup and test steps and verify them in a fresh clone
tasks.dod: Following README.md word for word in a fresh clone against an empty PostgreSQL database completes every command, every linked file exists, and no secret or shared database address appears.

tasks.title: Create the lib/format module for money, calendar days and moments with a fixed en-US locale
tasks.dod: formatMoney, formatDay and formatMoment are pure, use en-US regardless of the runtime locale and zone, and unit tests pin $1,234.50, UAH 1,234.50, the stored UTC day and a moment in UTC−10/UTC+14.

tasks.title: Route every displayed date and amount through lib/format and forbid ad-hoc formatting by lint
tasks.dod: Every list, dashboard, related-invoices, custom-price and editor display of a date or amount uses lib/format, lint rejects toFixed( and toLocale*String( in components/ and app/, and component tests show the stored day and $1,234.50 under a foreign TZ and locale.

tasks.title: Build the pure invoice document model with its wording in lib/invoice-document
tasks.dod: buildInvoiceDocument(source) returns every label, party, line, formatted date and amount for a draft form and for an issued invoice's issued details, and unit tests over the fixture set (draft, issued, USD, UAH, discount, tax, multiple lines) pass.

tasks.title: Lay out the HTML preview and the PDF from the document model and add the parity test
tasks.dod: The HTML preview and the react-pdf document render only InvoiceDocument fields, a draft with unsaved changes prints its last save, and the parity test shows 100 % identical text between preview and PDF over the fixture set.

tasks.title: Turn the editor store into a per-mount factory provided by context and built from server data
tasks.dod: Each editor mount gets its own store created synchronously from the RSC data and keyed by Freelancer and invoice, the initialize-in-effect and reset-on-unmount are gone, a lint rule forbids the old module-level store, and the existing invoice-integrity and editor component tests plus a new first-render test pass.

tasks.title: Compute a new invoice's today and due date on the server and reserve the invoice-number field
tasks.dod: The new-invoice page passes today in the Freelancer time zone (UTC until saved) and the payment-terms due date as initial data, the browser clock is never consulted, and the number field shows a size-reserved loading state; component tests pin both.

tasks.title: Add the store save command with a form revision and resolve every save outcome in it
tasks.dod: save(intent) reads the form when called, tags it with the form revision and resolves saved, saved-with-edits (totals recomputed from the lines on screen), issued-with-edits (dismissable notice), field errors and changed-elsewhere/totals-changed state; the 50-run race test shows 0 lost edits and totals always equal to the visible lines.

tasks.title: Route Retry, the created-address change and the save dialogs through the save command
tasks.dod: Retry calls save(lastFailedIntent) with the current form; a created invoice replaces the address with its edit URL from inside the command; changed-elsewhere and totals-changed open SCR-10/SCR-09 from store state for Save and Retry alike; Retry while saving or after a store swap is a no-op; component tests per outcome pass.

tasks.title: Send signed-in pages no-store, reload back/forward-cache restores, and prove AC-07 in Chromium and WebKit
tasks.dod: Signed-in page responses carry Cache-Control: private, no-store, SessionRestoreGuard hides and reloads a persisted pageshow before paint, security-headers.test.ts covers the header, and the AC-07 e2e passes in the chromium and webkit projects.

tasks.title: Give every editor field, line field, icon button and row action an announced name and tie errors to fields
tasks.dod: Every editor field has its visible label as its name, line fields announce «{column}, line {n}» from the current index, icon-only buttons and the hidden Print/Download text have names, row actions name the action and the invoice number, and refused fields carry aria-invalid + aria-describedby; component tests assert the names.

tasks.title: Render the editor's phone and desktop layouts from one DOM tree switched by CSS only
tasks.dod: The editor no longer uses useIsMobile to choose what renders, the server HTML at 390 px shows the phone layout, and an e2e test proves a focused line field with «12.» keeps its text and focus across a breakpoint resize; desktop/phone visual snapshots are recorded.

tasks.title: Add the shared AmountInput with a decimal keypad and use it for line, discount, tax and shipping fields
tasks.dod: AmountInput (inputMode=decimal, '.' the only accepted decimal separator) is used for line price and quantity, discount, tax rate and shipping, is registered in docs/design-system.md, and component tests show «12.5» accepted and «12,5» rejected.

tasks.title: Add the CI e2e job with the server/browser date matrix and the accessibility suite
tasks.dod: A CI e2e job builds the app for production against throwaway PostgreSQL and runs the date matrix (zones UTC−10/UTC/UTC+14, browser in another zone, ±5 min around midnight, 0 hydration errors, stored days everywhere) and the axe suite (0 serious/critical on editor new/existing, invoices list, dashboard); both pass.

tasks.title: Add e2e tests that reach every save outcome by Save and by Retry and compare the results
tasks.dod: For created, updated, issued, changed elsewhere, totals changed and field error, the e2e reaches the outcome once by Save and once by Retry (after a forced failure) and asserts the same address, dialog and unsaved flag.

tasks.title: Dispose the editor store on unmount so Retry and an in-flight create cannot act on another page, and remove the unused save-bypassing actions
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 D1 and S6 fixed. The store has dispose(), which bumps sessionToken and dismisses its failure toast (the toast gets a stable id). InvoiceEditorProvider calls it from a StrictMode-safe useEffect cleanup that re-arms in the effect body. replaceState after a create runs only while the token matches and location.pathname is still the create page. setIsSaving, markAsSaved and lastFailedIntent are removed. retry-through-save-command.test.ts unmounts the provider (not initialize()) and asserts: Retry after leaving does nothing, a create resolving after leaving does not change the address, and the toast is dismissed. Comments that describe the removed reset are corrected.

tasks.title: Open a new invoice with the default sender profile, its default bank account and currency, and request the invoice-number hint on mount
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 D2 and T-h(a) fixed. newInvoiceDefaults picks the default sender profile (falling back to the first), its default bank account (falling back to the first) and that account's currency. The store requests the number hint on mount when invoiceNumber is ''. An explicit hintStatus (idle|loading|ready|failed) drives 'Loading…'/aria-busy. A failed hint, a cleared number and a non-success generateInvoiceNumber leave the loading state at the same size. Component tests cover default selection, hint requested once, hint failure and cleared number; the provider test no longer expects an empty sender. An e2e asserts that the server HTML equals the hydrated editor for a new and an existing invoice, with no visible change on hydration.

tasks.title: Print an issued invoice with its stored line amounts and totals in the preview and the PDF
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 D3 fixed. buildInvoiceDocument({kind:'issued'}) takes line amounts from item.amount and subtotal/tax/total from the stored invoice; only the draft path recomputes. A fixture of an older issued invoice whose stored total differs from a recompute proves that the preview, the PDF and the list show the same stored total (unit + pdf-fidelity integration).

tasks.title: Keep the failed intent through the changed-totals confirmation so Save and issue stays Save and issue
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 D4 fixed. handleSaveFailure stores the intent alongside totalsChanged, and 'Confirm and save' calls save(thatIntent, { confirmedTotals }). Component and e2e cases cover TOTALS_CHANGED reached by Save and issue and by its Retry; both end issued.

tasks.title: Stop AmountInput from turning a typed comma decimal into a larger amount, and record the iPhone keypad check
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 D5 fixed. Typing '12,5' key by key never yields 125; the chosen behaviour is stated in the component comment and test (e.g. ',' is read as the decimal point, or the comma keystroke is rejected so that '12' + ',' + '5' cannot merge into 125). Tests assert input.value and the stored number after typing '12,5' and after pasting '1,234.50' (the previous valid value is kept). The real-iPhone check with a Ukrainian region is run and its result recorded in the review record / PR. If '.' is missing from the keypad, that goes to the spec owner as sad §11 says.

tasks.title: Name the phone more-actions button and the line product fields, tie the product error to its field, and run axe at phone width and after a refused save
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 D6 and T-b fixed. The more-actions trigger has aria-label 'More actions'. The product picker trigger and the custom-name input announce 'Product, line N', and the phone label is linked with htmlFor/id. The product FieldError has an id referenced by the trigger's aria-describedby. Component tests cover all three. accessibility.spec.ts runs axe at 390 px as well as at 1280 px, and adds a refused-save state that asserts the field exposes its error as its accessible description.

tasks.title: Show "Customer since" in the Freelancer time zone
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 D7 fixed. The customer page passes the Freelancer timeZone into CustomerInfoSidebar, and formatMoment uses it. A component test shows a Customer created late on the last day of a month in a zone east of UTC under the Freelancer's month.

tasks.title: Make every PDF action fail safely, show its preparing state, resist double clicks and popup blockers, and test the real triggers
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 D8, S5, S7 and S8 fixed. The document model is built inside runInput's try (passed as a thunk, built once), so a model error shows the 'could not be prepared / Try again' message and is reported to Sentry with its stage. Try again goes through the same path: it shows preparing and handles unauthorized. The trigger components render their pending/disabled state from usePdfAction().preparing, so a double click generates once. Print opens a window synchronously in the click, or on a null window shows a toast offering Download, and always revokes the object URL. useInvoicePdf builds the document only when Download/Print runs (getState()). Component tests drive the real row menu and editor header buttons with the loader mocked. The AC-01 e2e checks that a later Print and preview make no new toolkit request. Edge cases are added: Try again during classification makes one fetch and shows one message; a captive portal is reported with its stage.

tasks.title: Reword AC-01 and AC-02b for the HTML preview and remove the dead preview PDF action
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 D9 fixed (owner chose to reword the spec). spec.md AC-01/AC-02b say that the invoice preview is shown from the document model without fetching the PDF toolkit, and only Download and Print fetch it. The change is recorded in spec §9 (or the change log) with a reference to ADR-0002 and this review. The 'preview' branch of usePdfAction and its tests are removed. test-plan.md rows are updated to match.

tasks.title: Limit Cache-Control no-store to signed-in document and RSC responses
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 S1 fixed. proxy.ts skips isPublicPath(pathname) and file-extension paths (fonts, logo, manifest icons). no-store applies only to signed-in page documents and RSC requests. proxy.test.ts asserts that a font, the logo and an icon are not no-store, while a signed-in page and its RSC request are.

tasks.title: Make the CI e2e job fail instead of skipping without Docker, add a nightly full e2e run, and harden the PDF chunk gate
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 S2, S3 and S4 fixed. When CI is set, an unreachable container runtime fails the e2e job instead of skipping every test. .github/workflows has a scheduled (nightly) job that runs the full playwright suite in chromium and webkit with E2E_TIMING=1. check-pdf-chunks exits 1 when a chunk listed in a manifest is missing on disk, and exits 1 when no chunk (the lazy PDF chunk) contains a toolkit marker (positive control). Unit tests cover both new failure modes.

tasks.title: Capture Linux layout baselines from main, cover a new invoice, and re-verify the README on a fresh clone including e2e
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 T-c and T-d fixed. editor-layout.spec.ts covers a new and an existing invoice and checks the structure after hydration. Linux baselines are captured in CI's image (the before baseline from main), invoice numbers and dates are masked, and the tolerance is tightened. Plain `pnpm test:e2e` passes on a Linux clone. The README is re-run word for word on the current HEAD, including `pnpm exec playwright install` and `pnpm test:e2e`, and the audit log in _audit/ is refreshed.

tasks.title: Prove AC-07 by navigating back to the earlier Freelancer's invoice, between two invoices, and by direct address after sign-out
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 T-e fixed. session-isolation.spec.ts steps back until page.url() equals A's editor URL (asserted) and finds no A invoice data. The 500 ms sleep and the leaks reset are replaced by a wait on /login. A direct GET of A's editor address after sign-out returns no invoice number. A Back/Forward e2e between invoices X and Y of one Freelancer shows the right invoice each time. The WebKit project runs in the nightly job (T31).

tasks.title: Prove AC-07 on a restored (bfcache) page: no-store and the restore guard keep A's invoice off screen
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 T-e (bfcache part) fixed. An e2e runs full Chromium (channel 'chromium') with the back/forward cache enabled and first asserts a control: a page without no-store IS restored from bfcache (pageshow persisted=true), so the run is not vacuous. Test 1 (app as served): A's editor, sign-out, B signs in, Back to A's editor: the editor carries no-store, is not restored, and no frame shows A's invoice data. Test 2 (guard alone): with Cache-Control stripped in the browser, A's editor is restored and SessionRestoreGuard keeps A's data off screen; disabling the guard turns it red. Removing proxy.ts no-store alone stays green because Next.js also sends no-store on the dynamic editor page (recorded).

tasks.title: Extend the date matrix to the preview, the PDF and a new invoice's today, with hard-coded expectations
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 T-f fixed. date-matrix.spec.ts asserts literal strings (e.g. 'Mar 15, 2027'; 'Mar 16, 2027' for Kiritimati on the custom price), not values computed by lib/format. It reads the editor preview's dates and the downloaded PDF's text, and opens /invoices/new at 23:58 in UTC+14 to check today and the due date. Related invoices are matched within their own row.

tasks.title: Prove money formatting independent of device language on the screens, and test parity against a really rendered PDF
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 T-a fixed. A Playwright test with locale uk-UA and de-DE checks the preview text, the downloaded PDF text, editor line and summary totals, and dashboard Debtors for '$1,234.50' and 'UAH 1,234.50'. format.test.ts runs money and day cases under describe.each(['en-US','uk-UA','de-DE']). The parity test extracts text from a real pdf(doc).toBuffer() (fonts served locally) and compares it with the preview text.

tasks.title: Add the save-flow UI and integration tests the plan names, and randomise when the mid-save edit happens
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 T-g fixed. Component tests: leaving after a save with a mid-save edit warns about unsaved changes (AC-03); the refusal UI keeps the mid-save change on screen (AC-05); IssuedEditsDroppedNotice is shown with its wording, can be dismissed, lines are locked and the allowed fields stay editable (AC-05b). An integration test shows editor totals equal stored totals to the cent (AC-04). save-command-race.test.ts randomises the number of microtask ticks before and after resolve(), and adds two edits in one save, a line deleted mid-save, and notes changed during Save and issue being stored by the next Save.

tasks.title: Scan for editor components rendering their own dialog, test the theme switcher in both places, and drop the removed Drawer from the map
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-10 T-h(b-e) fixed. repository-hygiene.test.ts (or lint) fails if a component under components/invoice-editor/ renders its own dialog. The 200 ms sleep in invoice-editor-confirmation-modal-close.test.tsx is replaced by awaiting the lazy import or a condition. A component test renders components/theme-toggle.tsx in the landing and the signed-in header and asserts the same behaviour. docs/architecture-map.md no longer lists Drawer.

tasks.title: Keep the editor and its edits through the first Save after a create
tasks.dod: Review r2 N1. First an e2e: create a new invoice, then Save (and, separately, Save and issue) while a quantity is typed during the update; assert the typed value and 'Unsaved' survive and the issued notice is not wiped. Same after a successful Retry create. If it fails, fix it, e.g. switch to router.replace right after the create while nothing is in flight, or keep the live store when the edit page mounts for the same invoice and Freelancer. The e2e passes at HEAD.

tasks.title: Print an issued invoice opened in the editor with its stored amounts in the preview and in Download/Print
tasks.dod: Review r2 N2 (D3 remainder). When the editor mode is issued or cancelled, the preview and use-invoice-pdf build the model from the stored line amounts and totals (ADR-0002:45), not a recalculation. A component test opens a legacy issued invoice whose stored totals differ from a recalculation and asserts the stored figures in the preview and in the Download model. money-locale.spec.ts seeds stored amounts that differ from the recalculation.

tasks.title: Reject every comma in AmountInput, as AC-13 is written
tasks.dod: Review r2 N3; owner decision: reject the comma. Any change containing ',' keeps the previous value (no '12,5' -> 12.5, no '1,000' -> 1, no '12,5' -> 125). Component comment, docs/design-system.md AmountInput row and tests agree with spec AC-13, ux-flows K4, sad Flow 10 and test-plan. Tests type '12,5' and '1,000' key by key and paste '1,234.50', and assert input.value and the stored number for line quantity, price, Discount, Shipping and Tax (onPrice last call / store formData field).

tasks.title: Show that the PDF is being prepared on the row menu and the editor buttons
tasks.dod: Review r2 N4 (D8c remainder). InvoiceRowActions (list, dashboard) and the editor Download/Print show the same preparing indication as related invoices and the preview dialog (spinner + aria-busy or a 'Preparing PDF...' status) while preparing. Component tests assert the visible/announced state, not only toBeDisabled.

tasks.title: Make the PDF on-demand tests able to fail
tasks.dod: Review r2 test gaps. pdf-on-demand.spec.ts: in a fresh visit, open the preview first and assert no toolkit chunk was fetched; the later-Print reuse check waits until the print finished (popup on blob: URL) and pending response handlers settled. pdf-triggers-real: a successful Print fires load and asserts revokeObjectURL (no conditional). pdf-kit-load-edge: no setTimeout sync; add Try again while the failed load is still being classified; count toolkit import attempts through the loader.

tasks.title: Prove AC-06 hydration and AC-07 isolation through the client router
tasks.dod: Review r2 test gaps. editor-first-display.spec.ts waits for a real hydration signal, compares the full settled body with the server HTML (number description masked), drops the 500 ms sleep and fails on hydration/render-mismatch console errors (watchRenderErrors). session-isolation.spec.ts: Y has its own Customer, line and total and all are asserted; X->Y via in-app navigation (router.push) then Back/Forward; the Visitor's Back is proven to reach A's editor URL. session-isolation-bfcache test 1 asserts no {path: editorPathA, persisted: true}; the WebKit run records pageshow.persisted.

tasks.title: Close the remaining save-flow, date and hygiene test gaps
tasks.dod: Review r2 test gaps. AC-09: component test that Download/Print are disabled with unsaved changes, plus the planned e2e (unsaved quantity change, download from the list, PDF shows the last save). StrictMode renderWithEditorStore case: save a new invoice, assert the address and isSaving. editor-retry-parity.spec.ts confirms totals-changed on the bySave page and asserts PENDING. T36 component test: Home after a mid-save edit shows UnsavedChangesDialog; after dismissing the notice, Save carries the allowed fields. save-command-race: fixed default seed (env override), each interleaving class asserted to occur. CustomerDetailView with timeZone asserts 'Customer since' in that zone. repository-hygiene dialog scan also matches @radix-ui/react-(alert-)?dialog, vaul and <dialog, with negative controls.

tasks.title: Fix the PDF failure tag, the number-hint sign-in, static-route caching and isSaving after dispose
tasks.dod: Review r2 stage 2. use-pdf-action tags new-version as pdf.stage=version and offline as fetch (sad:585), with a unit assertion. requestNumberHint's catch calls goToSignIn() like selectSenderProfile. proxy.ts also skips staticAssetRoutes and iconPathPattern (/opengraph-image, /twitter-image, /icon/<id>) but keeps no-store on signed-in pages; proxy.test covers them. dispose() also clears isSaving, with a test of remount after dispose.

tasks.title: Harden the nightly e2e and integration CI, and prove pnpm test:e2e on Linux at HEAD
tasks.dod: Review r2 stage 1/2. e2e-nightly.yml: permissions contents: read, upload test-results on failure, job named for what it runs, runs in the same Playwright image as the baselines. Integration suites use containerRuntimeDecision (fail when CI is set) and the T36 suite has the skip marker. New-invoice layout baseline re-taken on purpose with the default sender filled in; the main SHA and command used for baselines are recorded. A full pnpm test:e2e run on Linux at the final HEAD is logged under _audit/.

tasks.title: Bring the SAD and the architecture map in line with the shipped code
tasks.dod: Review r2 doc drift. sad.md:18,187 no longer say the preview fetches the toolkit. docs/architecture-map.md state and PDF rows point at create-invoice-editor-store.ts / invoice-editor-provider.tsx and lib/pdf/load-pdf-kit.ts / lib/invoice-document/index.ts, and list lib/format and components/session-restore-guard.tsx.

tasks.title: Don't send the device to sign-in when the number-hint request was cut off by leaving the page
tasks.dod: Found during T43: requestNumberHint's catch (T45) calls goToSignIn() for any rejection, so leaving the editor while the hint is in flight (client navigation, or a full page load that aborts the action) sends the tab to the clear-session route and overrides the user's own navigation. A rejection after the store was disposed (sessionToken moved) or while the page is unloading (pagehide) does not call goToSignIn; a genuine rejection while the editor is shown still does (AC-21). Same guard for selectSenderProfile. Unit tests cover all three cases.

tasks.title: Show and announce that the PDF is being prepared on the phone editor, from a live region outside the buttons
tasks.dod: Review r3 R1. One always-mounted role="status" aria-live="polite" region per trigger surface, outside any <button> or menu item; only its text changes while preparing (same pattern as AmountInput). Below md, the "More actions" trigger shows the spinner and aria-busy while a Download or Print chosen from it is preparing. The status is not hidden by the desktop-only container. Component tests: a phone-width case picks Download and Print from the menu and asserts the trigger is busy and the status text is set; the desktop case asserts the status is not a descendant of the button.

tasks.title: Make the hand-over to the edit page after a create keep focus, scroll and in-flight edits, without Next internals
tasks.dod: Review r3 R2, F2, F4. The provider uses useRouter() from next/navigation (tests mock next/navigation), not next/dist internals. The hand-over decision rests on startedAsNew plus the store invoiceId, not on window.location ordering against replaceState. router.replace is called with { scroll: false }, and the focused field (and caret) is restored after the swap, or both routes share one layout that keeps the editor mounted. The save-command.ts comment on replaceState describes the real behaviour. E2e: hold the create request, type a quantity while it runs, release it, keep typing after the swap; assert the full value, "Unsaved", the on-screen total (AC-04) and that the next Save stores it. Replace the 2 s sleeps in editor-first-save-after-create.spec.ts with a deterministic signal; assert or drop __sameNode in the AC-05b case; refresh the header comment. The hand-over component test gains a StrictMode case with a save in flight.

tasks.title: Make the toolkit-fetch tracker in the PDF on-demand e2e wait for its own handlers
tasks.dod: Review r3 F3. trackToolkitChunks keeps the pending body-classification promises and every "no toolkit fetched" assertion awaits them (or records chunk URLs on request); the fixed 500 ms settle is gone. A negative control shows the tracker reports a chunk fetched just before the assertion.

tasks.title: Record the store hand-over in the ADRs and fix the remaining PDF wording in ux-flows and the SAD
tasks.dod: Review r3 R4, R5. ADR-0003 and ADR-0005 are amended (or ADR-0008 added) for the hand-over: the key (owner, invoice), who claims an entry, when it is disposed, and why it is safe for AC-07; spec §6.1 points the security review at it. ux-flows.md:20 says the preview is HTML and the editor only warms the toolkit when idle. sad Flow 8 says Download/Print are disabled while there are unsaved changes and the model is built when the action is chosen. updated_at is bumped in sad, ux-flows and test-plan.

tasks.title: Tidy the route JSDoc, verify the nightly Docker CLI download, reuse StoredAmounts and fix a stale test comment
tasks.dod: Review r3 F6. isStaticAssetPath sits above the AC-05 allowlist JSDoc in config/routes.config.ts. e2e-nightly.yml pins the Docker CLI version and checks its sha256 before extracting. The { subtotal; taxAmount; total } shape in store/invoice-editor-store/types.ts and types/invoice/types.ts reuses StoredAmounts from lib/invoice-document/types.ts. The session-isolation.spec.ts comment about the cut-off hint request reflects T45b (or the wait is dropped so the test proves T45b).

tasks.title: Make plain pnpm test:e2e pass on Linux and record the reviewed layout baselines
tasks.dod: Review r3 R3. The WebKit "navigation interrupted by another navigation to /dashboard" failure is traced to its cause (sign-in helper waits for the post-sign-in URL to settle, or a product fix) and fixed; us03-status-lifecycle and session-isolation-bfcache:311 failures are explained and fixed. workers is set in playwright.config.ts when CI is set, so the README command is the one that passes. A plain CI=1 pnpm test:e2e on Linux at the final HEAD is logged green under _audit/. The three re-captured layout baselines are compared against the 72cf58b images and the owner review is recorded; one compare run on x86_64 (or the nightly) is on record.

tasks.title: Restore focus after the create hand-over on every editor field, not only fields with an aria-label
tasks.dod: Review r4 P1. captureFocus/restoreFocus match the focused field on a key that is stable across a client mount (e.g. a data-field form-path attribute or name/aria-label on every editor field), never on a useId()-derived id. Invoice number, PO number, Notes, Payment terms, Terms, Discount, Shipping and Tax rate keep focus and caret across the swap. The component test renders the real NotesSection (or the invoice-number field) instead of a stand-in input, and fails on the old code. One e2e types into Notes across the swap and asserts the full typed text.

tasks.title: Guard the create hand-over: move only from the new or the edit address, and adopt an entry only once
tasks.dod: Review r4 P2. router.replace to the edit page runs only when location.pathname is invoicesNew or invoiceEdit(id), so Back pressed during a create is not overridden; the check does not depend on the order of set() and history.replaceState. The useState initializer adopts only an entry with !claimed, as ADR-0003's amendment says.
